text: Ten fictional nonprofit programme passages, each with two variants of three kinds of altered quote (changed quantity, reordered, moved negation) for citation-checker testing.

passages.source_passage: Since 2019, the Kparo Valley School Meals Initiative has served a daily hot lunch to pupils in 14 primary schools across Tamberi District. Before the programme began, head teachers reported that nearly one in three children arrived at school without having eaten breakfast. Attendance in the lean season fell to 61 percent, and many pupils did not return after the midday break. Local farmers' cooperatives now supply about two thirds of the millet, while the district council supplies the cowpeas. Cooks are currently not paid a stipend, although storekeepers are. The current budget does not cover the six newest schools, which joined the district register in 2023. This proposal seeks funding to extend meals to those schools and to train forty cooks in safe food handling.

variants.changed_quantity_2: The current budget does not cover the six newest schools, which joined the district register in 2021.

passages.source_passage: During 2023, the Sundarpur Mothers' Outreach Project ran mobile antenatal clinics in 22 villages of Haripal Block. Community midwives registered 1,140 pregnant women, and 78 percent of them completed at least four antenatal visits. Facility births rose from 412 in the previous year to 590, largely because the project's two ambulances were available around the clock. Postnatal home visits reached first-time mothers but not most adolescent mothers, who often live with in-laws outside the catchment. No maternal deaths were recorded among registered women this year, although two newborn deaths occurred at home. We were not able to open the planned newborn care corner at Bhatpara Health Post, because the building lease was delayed until March 2024. We ask the foundation to carry the unspent amount forward.

passages.source_passage: The mid-term evaluation of the Dryline Seeds for Resilience project covered 36 months of implementation in Ostara and Kemmel counties. Of the 2,400 households enrolled, 1,650 had planted at least one drought-tolerant sorghum variety by the 2023 long rains. Yields on demonstration plots averaged 1.8 tonnes per hectare, compared with 1.1 tonnes on farmers' own plots. The evaluators found that women farmers adopted the new seed faster than men, but men controlled most of the harvest sales. Seed multiplication groups were not yet profitable, and none had registered as a business. Rainwater harvesting pits were adopted in Ostara but not in Kemmel, where soils are rockier. The team recommends that the project not expand to new counties but deepen support in existing ones.

variants.changed_quantity_2: The mid-term evaluation of the Dryline Seeds for Resilience project covered 30 months of implementation in Ostara and Kemmel counties.

passages.source_passage: Session 3: Running the first share-purchase meeting. Each savings group should have between 15 and 25 members, and every member may buy one to five shares per meeting. Set the share value with the group; in most Lumbe villages it is 200 shillings. Remind members that the cash box is never opened outside a meeting, and that three key-holders, not the chairperson, keep the keys. Members may borrow from the social fund but not from the loan fund during the first 12 weeks. The record-keeper writes each purchase in the member's passbook, and the money-counters announce the total aloud. Let visitors watch the count but not handle the cash. If a member misses a meeting, a friend may buy shares on her behalf.

passages.source_passage: Mvuli District has a population of roughly 310,000 people, but only 9 health facilities staffed by clinicians. In 2022 the district health office recruited 240 community health workers, each responsible for about 120 households. A baseline survey found that 43 percent of children with fever had not been tested for malaria within 24 hours. Health workers received a five-day initial training but no refresher training in the following year. Stock-outs are common: rapid tests were available in most months, while oral rehydration salts were not. Supervisors visit urban villages monthly but rarely reach hill villages, where travel takes a full day. Community health workers are paid travel costs but not a regular stipend, and attrition reached 18 percent last year. This proposal addresses these gaps.

passages.source_passage: In the year ending June 2024, the Tumaini Home Care Network supported 860 clients living with HIV across Rombasi and Kiwele wards. Our 52 volunteer caregivers made 9,300 home visits, roughly eleven per client over the year. Viral suppression among clients on treatment rose from 71 percent to 84 percent. Caregivers delivered medicines to bedridden clients but not to clients who could walk to the clinic. We met our target for adherence clubs but not for disclosure counselling, reaching 140 families rather than 200. No caregiver left the network during the year, although two took extended leave. Food parcels were funded by the county in Rombasi, while Kiwele relied on church donations. We remain grateful for your continued support.

variants.changed_quantity_2: Viral suppression among clients on treatment rose from 71 percent to 89 percent.
variants.reordered: Food parcels were funded by the county in Kiwele, while Rombasi relied on church donations.

variants.moved_negation: Caregivers delivered medicines not to bedridden clients but to clients who could walk to the clinic.
variants.moved_negation_2: We met our target not for adherence clubs but for disclosure counselling, reaching 140 families rather than 200.

passages.source_passage: In Lorrenvale Province, an estimated 38 percent of adults over 25 cannot read a simple sentence, and the rate among women is nearly twice that among men. The Lantern Evening Classes network began in 2017 with four classes in church halls and now runs 31 classes in schools, mosques and community centres. Learners attend three evenings a week for nine months. Most learners are farmers and market traders who did not complete primary school. Facilitators are volunteers who receive training materials but not a stipend. Classes in town have electric lighting, but rural classes still depend on kerosene lamps. Graduates have not had access to follow-on reading materials, so many lose skills within a year. This proposal requests support for solar lamps and a graduate library.

variants.moved_negation_2: Graduates have had access to follow-on reading materials, so not many lose skills within a year.

passages.source_passage: This mid-term review assessed the Ngaro Clean Water Project eighteen months after launch in Bekwai and Sumo sub-counties. Of the 40 boreholes planned, 27 have been drilled and 24 were functioning at the time of the visit. Water committees collected user fees in Bekwai but not in Sumo, where committees had not yet opened bank accounts. Household latrine coverage rose from 34 percent at baseline to 58 percent. Handwashing stations were found beside most school latrines, but soap was present at only 1 in 5. Women reported shorter queues at boreholes, while men reported fewer disputes. The evaluators found evidence of open defecation along the river but not near schools. The project is unlikely to reach all 40 sites by 2025 without a no-cost extension.

variants.changed_quantity_2: Of the 40 boreholes planned, 27 have been drilled and 21 were functioning at the time of the visit.
variants.reordered: Women reported fewer disputes, while men reported shorter queues at boreholes.
variants.reordered_2: Water committees collected user fees in Sumo but not in Bekwai, where committees had not yet opened bank accounts.
variants.moved_negation: The evaluators found evidence of open defecation not along the river but near schools.
variants.moved_negation_2: Water committees collected user fees not in Bekwai but in Sumo, where committees had not yet opened bank accounts.

passages.source_passage: Between February and May 2024, the Kalinde Nets for Every Sleeping Space campaign distributed 186,000 long-lasting insecticidal nets in Maroba and Tesi districts. Registration teams counted 97,500 households, and nets were allocated at one per two people. Coverage surveys six weeks later found that 81 percent of children under five had slept under a net the previous night. Distribution points opened on schedule in Maroba, while Tesi was delayed by flooding. Nets were handed to card holders but not to unregistered households, and about 1,200 families had to return a second day. Pregnant women received nets at antenatal clinics, not at distribution points. Malaria cases at health facilities have fallen in Maroba but not in Tesi, which is unsurprising after the flooding.

variants.changed_quantity_2: Coverage surveys eight weeks later found that 81 percent of children under five had slept under a net the previous night.
variants.reordered: Distribution points opened on schedule in Tesi, while Maroba was delayed by flooding.

variants.moved_negation: Nets were handed not to card holders but to unregistered households, and about 1,200 families had to return a second day.
variants.moved_negation_2: Malaria cases at health facilities have fallen not in Maroba but in Tesi, which is unsurprising after the flooding.

passages.source_passage: In the 2023 school year, the Puente Becas programme provided full scholarships to 215 girls attending secondary schools in the highland department of San Lázaro de Arriba. Each scholarship covers fees, uniforms, books and a monthly transport allowance. Retention was strong: 94 percent of scholars completed the year, compared with a departmental average of 71 percent for girls. Eleven scholars left the programme, most often because of early marriage or migration, not academic failure. Mentors met scholars twice a month in rural schools but only monthly in town schools. We did not reach our goal of placing every graduate in a paid internship; only 19 of 32 graduates secured one. Scholars' families contributed volunteer hours but not cash, and none was asked to repay support.
